Hello Team,
Hope you are doing good.
We have received a case from an end customer concerning a power converter, as shown in the picture attached below.
We would like to recommend you reboot the charger in such
behavior, and this error is reproduced due to the internal communication of converter.
We need to check for the ethernet cable connection or any other loose connection towards the power converter with serial no
2102312VGQKXN7001187SA002204000204
and have a spare power converter to troubleshoot or replace it.
Kindly refer to this KA to resolve this issue.
